findings.title: The feature notes leave out what an owner checks first

location.description: the three feature notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The owner cannot tell whether their own till, card reader or distributor works with Shelfmark, or who handles returns, so the trial button asks them to act on trust.

current.value: No till, card reader or distributor is named; "Returns are tracked for you" does not say who tracks them; nothing compares Shelfmark with what the owner does now.

findings.target: The notes name the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with what the owner does now.
findings.fix_direction: The maker must supply the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with what the owner does now, such as a stock count or a spreadsheet. Then change "Returns are tracked for you" to say who tracks them. Do not invent any of these facts.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees in the three feature notes, in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports, the named tills and card readers, the named distributors, who tracks returns, and one comparison with what the owner does now.

findings.title: Feature note lines are under 45 characters on desktop and widescreen

location.description: the first feature note in the row of three

findings.viewer_experience: The notes are short, so the even row reads well, but the lines run at 32.5 and 40 characters, under the 45 the work order asked for.
findings.fix_direction: If the maker wants the number met, widen the notes by narrowing the gap between columns.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) and p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more

findings.title: The phone headline leaves "before a" alone on its line

location.description: the headline at the top of the phone page

findings.viewer_experience: The headline runs to four lines and splits "a customer" across lines, so the "before a" line reads weak.
findings.target: The headline does not leave "before a" alone on its line or split "a customer".
findings.fix_direction: Apply the break after "is" only at wider viewports, or let the phone headline wrap on its own.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the phone headline without "before a" alone on a line and without "a customer" split across lines.

findings.title: Two table title cells wrap on the phone

location.description: the "Notes from the Ferry" title cell in the reorder table on the phone

findings.viewer_experience: "The Glass Orchard" and "Notes from the Ferry" each take two lines, so two of the five rows are taller than the rest.
findings.fix_direction: Give the title column a little more width than the two number columns, so that at most one title wraps.

closed_when.check: lines of tbody > tr:nth-of-type(4) > td:nth-of-type(1) and tbody > tr:nth-of-type(5) > td:nth-of-type(1) in the phone viewport is 1 for at least one of them
